title: Surreal Mustache Portrait
description: A surreal collage-style portrait of a man with a large curled mustache, his face and neck composed of interlocking jigsaw puzzle pieces filled with text and symbols. A black cat with glowing eyes sits on his shoulder. The background features two golden suns, floating letters, musical notes, cats, mustaches, and puzzle pieces scattered across a purple and yellow painted sky.
prompt: Surreal mixed media painting of a man's head and shoulders made from interlocking white jigsaw puzzle pieces covered in black text and symbols, featuring a prominent curled mustache. A sleek black cat with yellow eyes sits on his right shoulder. Scattered floating elements include golden suns with rays, large colorful letters, musical notes, small purple cats, and mustache icons against a dreamy purple and yellow sky.
